title: Putative mechanism of a multivitamin treatment against insulin resistance.
authors: Palma-Jacinto, Jose Antonio; Lopez-Lopez, Edgar; Medina-Franco, Jose Luis; Montero-Ruiz, Oreth; Santiago-Roque, Isela
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过数据挖掘和分子对接探讨维生素抗炎机制，虽涉及NF-κB等转录因子，但核心是维生素-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Insulin resistance is caused by the abnormal secretion of proinflammatory cytokines in adipose tissue, which is induced by an increase in lipid accumulation in adipocytes, hepatocytes, and myocytes. The inflammatory pathway involves multiple targets such as nuclear factor kappa B, inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa-B kinase, and mitogen-activated protein kinase. Vitamins are micronutrients with anti-inflammatory activities that have unclear mechanisms. The present study aimed to describe the putative mechanisms of vitamins involved in the inflammatory pathway of insulin resistance. The strategy to achieve this goal was to integrate data mining and analysis, target prediction, and molecular docking simulation calculations to support our hypotheses. Our results suggest that the multitarget activity of vitamins A, B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, B12, C, D3, and E inhibits nuclear factor kappa B and mitogen-activated protein kinase, in addition to vitamins A and B12 against inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa-B kinase. The findings of this study highlight the pharmacological potential of using an anti-inflammatory and multitarget treatment based on vitamins and open new perspectives to evaluate the inhibitory activity of vitamins against nuclear factor kappa B, mitogen-activated protein kinase, and inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa-B kinase in an insulin-resistant context.
abstract_zh: 胰岛素抵抗是由脂肪组织中促炎细胞因子的异常分泌引起的，而这种分泌是由脂肪细胞、肝细胞和肌细胞中脂质积累增加所诱导的。炎症通路涉及多个靶点，如核因子κB (nuclear factor kappa B)、核因子κB激酶抑制剂 (inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa-B kinase) 和丝裂原活化蛋白激酶 (mitogen-activated protein kinase)。维生素是具有抗炎活性的微量营养素，但其机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在描述维生素参与胰岛素抵抗炎症通路的假定机制。实现这一目标的策略是整合数据挖掘与分析、靶点预测和分子对接模拟计算来支持我们的假设。我们的结果表明，维生素A、B1、B2、B3、B5、B6、B7、B12、C、D3和E的多靶点活性抑制了核因子κB和丝裂原活化蛋白激酶，此外，维生素A和B12还针对核因子κB激酶抑制剂。本研究的发现突显了基于维生素的抗炎和多靶点治疗的药理学潜力，并为在胰岛素抵抗背景下评估维生素对核因子κB、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶和核因子κB激酶抑制剂的抑制活性开辟了新视角。
